system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Simon Peter stepping over the side of a fishing boat onto the dark waves, with Jesus standing on the water a few paces away in a simple undyed tunic and mantle","action":"Peter leans out from the gunwale, one foot lowered onto the surface of the water as he steps toward Jesus, arms slightly extended for balance; Jesus faces him with a calm open gesture","setting":"Sea of Galilee at night in the fourth watch, a wind-whipped lake with high rough waves, the fishing boat rocking, rocky hills and a faint village shore in the distance","secondaryElements":"Remaining disciples crowded in the boat, gripping the sides and gazing, soaked garments and spray; a faint lantern glow inside the boat; wind-tossed sail rigging","mood":"Tense wonder and trembling faith, luminous grace against sacred dread of the storm","timeOfDay":"Night, the fourth watch before dawn, dim starlit sky with faint moonlight on the water","composition":"Wide horizontal frame with the boat in the lower left and Peter in mid-step at center, Jesus standing on the waves at center right, dark sea and sky filling the upper space"}
